summary: Added approval_ttl_test.go (new file, CRLF like its siblings, package server) that pins D0-012 in AcquireGrant with three tests. (1) A sensitive approval sent ttl_seconds=1800 lives the configured 2 minutes. (2) A sensitive approval sent ttl_seconds=10 is not refused and also lives the configured 2 minutes.
